card.name: Whole-number digit before a decimal point
card.fires_on: A single digit that is the whole-number part of a decimal figure, right before the decimal point. It appears in results, lab values and dose numbers.

modes.label: Survival and fold-change results
modes.description: The leading digit of a measured result such as months, fold-increase or risk estimate.

modes.label: Limits and ranges
modes.description: The leading digit of a decimal threshold or range endpoint, such as a multiple of ULN or hours.

card.writes: It favors a period or full stop next to the digit and discourages dotted continuations such as .Z or .H.
card.plain: It marks the first digit of a decimal number just before the point, as in 2.4 or 6.1.
